narrative_shape: Read-only research whose visible turns are dominated by waiting on a long census job. From T68 the narration is 'standing by', 'waiting for the census job', 'wait for the next monitor event'; a second census is armed at T84 and the run then sits on block-count progress through level 0 (T99-119). Context barely moves (143k->146k across T105-T150). Census completes around T149 and analysis begins (T150). Productive waiting on a legitimately long job, but nearly every turn from ~T68 to T150 is a poll.

early_signals.signal: Only 8 reads and 1 write against 66 Bash; zero edits; narration is waiting language ('standing by')

T99-105 repeated 'still waiting for next block-count line'; context flat (143k)

rationale: Pure wait/poll posture from the earliest visible turn: one Bash per turn with waiting narration, flat context, no edits. Not a failure (the job finishes and analysis follows), but the poll turns carry no new information. Labelled as a poll/monitor shape rather than build or thrash.
